title: MVEE:  A Framework for Evolutionary Studies
description: MVEE reflects where I was at in January 2018 ( solo presentation ) in thinking about Biology, Evolution, Active Inference, Free Energy Principle, and more.  Uploaded to Zenodo in 2024.

methods.name: Extension of Variational Neuroethology (Ramstead et al. 2017) to evolution
methods.description: Builds the proposed MVEE framework by extending VNE toward a general framework for evolutionary studies.
methods.evidence: Extend Variational Neuroethology (Ramstead et al. 2017) to specify a tractable general framework for all Evolutionary studies, Biological and Otherwise.

methods.name: Genotype-Environment-Phenotype tensor representation through time
methods.description: Represents evolving systems as a dynamic multiscale G-E-P tensor over time, using only measurable quantities instead of fitness.
methods.evidence: Biology ∈ ℝGEP Generalized, Dynamic, multiscale Tensor representation of Any Evolving System. Free from “Fitness”!

methods.name: Pairing of state models and process models across scales
methods.description: Distinguishes predictive state theories (e.g. R = h2S) from algorithmic process theories and combines them via coarse-graining.
methods.evidence: Broadly we can consider two types of theory -- State and Process theories:

methods.name: Proposed compute-graph (TensorFlow) machine-learning architecture
methods.description: Proposes a single integrated ML framework on existing biological data to jointly consider coarse-grained state and process models.
methods.evidence: By using a single integrated machine learning framework on pre-existing biological data (TensorFlow/compute-graph), MVEE jointly and optimally considers coarse-grained state and process models across scales.

methods.name: Worked example: 'Pogo Foraging' state/process models across three scales
methods.description: Sketches state and process models for one ant colony over a day, a population of colonies over a summer, and populations over intergenerational time.

key_findings: The talk claims EcoEvoDevo is stuck in a locally-optimizing regime because of an incoherent genotype-phenotype-environment and fitness framing.
It argues the data, theory and philosophy already exist for a tractable generalized model of evolution, with the challenge being integrating VNE with classical theory using limited data.
It critiques VNE's human-cognition case study as not yet operationalized for actual data and unclear for other evolutionary systems.
It proposes MVEE (Multilevel Variational Evolutionary Ecology) as a framework combining VNE, EcoEvoDevo, collective behavior and machine learning.
key_findings_evidence: Claim 1: EcoEvoDevo is trapped in a locally-optimizing regime because it is trapped in an incoherent G-P-E & F phrasing.
The challenge lies in finding how to integrate the VNE with classical evolutionary theory and apply it to real systems using limited empirical data.
The case study in VNE on human cognition is still not operationalized in a way that allows usage of actual data:
MVEE == Variational Neuroethology + EcoEvoDevo + Collective Behavior + ML
